high_level_description: The image shows a person sitting on a gray couch in what appears to be a cozy indoor setting. The individual is wearing a sleeveless black top and black shorts, accessorized with a watch on their left wrist. They have dark hair tied back and are wearing large, dark sunglasses. In the background, there is a white wall with a decorative tapestry featuring green leaves hanging above the person. To the left of the person, there is a small white microwave placed on a wooden shelf. Next to the microwave, there is a small plant with long, green leaves.
